newsitem.title: USA: Safeway boosts stake in SSI Equity.
newsitem.headline: Safeway boosts stake in SSI Equity.

text.p: Safeway Inc Monday said it acquired an additional 13.6 percent of the partnership interests in SSI Equity Associates LP for $124.9 million.

In a statement, Safeway said SSI Equity Associates LP is a limited partnership whose sole assets are warrants to purchase 23.4 million shares of Safeway common stock at $1.00 per share. Safeway acquired the limited partnership interests with bank borrowings.
Safeway said the interests were acquired from a party unrelated to Safeway or any of its affiliates.

Safeway made its first acquisition of interests in SSI Equity Associates in January 1995. Since then, Safeway has acquired additional interests and said it may acquire additional interests in the future depending on market conditions and other factors.
With the 13.6 percent just acquired, Safeway now owns 74.1 percent of SSI Equity Associates. In calculating earnings per share, Safeway considers the warrants to be common stock equivalents.

Safeway said the acquisition of limited partnership interests will reduce the common stock equivalents by 3.1 million shares which, in turn, will slightly increase earnings per share beginning in the fourth quarter of 1996.

The favorable effect on earnings per share of reducing common stock equivalents will be partially offset by interest expense on the bank borrowings, Safeway said. If the transaction had closed on the first day of 1996, Safeway estimates that the transaction would have increased 1996 earnings by less than $0.01 a share.
